candidate_formula: S0/(1+lambda*max(0,D_adj-2*L/(L-1)*CV2)) for L>1; zero penalty for L=1
random_reference: exact expectation of D_adj over uniform permutations of the same indexed capacity multiset; no Monte Carlo
two_layer_convention: excess is exactly zero: both possible orders have the same mismatch
selection_objective: maximize development Spearman rho against negative validation perplexity; exact ties prefer smaller lambda
selection_scope: one full-development coefficient per mechanism; no selecting by local pair or budget results
official_ablation_interface: uncentered adjacent penalty at v2-selected lambda, removing only the random-permutation reference
near_score_primary_diagnostic: original log margin <0.01 (approximately 1%); fixed before v2 evaluation, chosen after viewing v1 diagnostics
near_score_secondary_diagnostic: original log margin <0.05; also show every predefined band

stability_analysis.report: held-out-fold metrics and correction counts; do not rank scores pooled across folds with different lambdas
stability_analysis.interpretation: development stability analysis only, not untouched validation: all development labels have previously been inspected

success_interpretation: report all predefined outcomes; local improvements alone do not establish overall or causal benefit
final_labels: never open or hash; final evaluation excluded
v1_policy: preserve all v1 frozen source and result hashes
